2. Closing. Closing shall occur no earlier than 60 days after signing and shall be conditioned on satisfactory completion of diligence and delivery of customary closing deliverables.

3. Representations. The Seller represents and warrants that it has authority to enter into this Agreement, valid title to the Shares, no undisclosed liabilities, compliance with applicable law, no pending or threatened litigation other than as disclosed, accurate tax matters, and no material adverse change.

receiver.private_reasoning: The revised draft is better on process and diligence, but the purchase price remains well above what the Buyer can support. receiver.requested_changes: 1) Reduce purchase price substantially from USD 41.5 million; target a number well below Seller’s ask and toward the disclosed internal reservation price. 2) Keep the extended closing/diligence condition, but clarify that Buyer has discretion to confirm satisfaction of diligence and closing deliverables. 3) Maintain the expanded Seller reps, and consider adding bring-down at closing plus a fundamental reps survival period. 4) Confidentiality language is generally acceptable, subject to customary carve-outs for advisers, financing sources, regulators, and legally compelled disclosures. 5) Remove any hidden/embedded confidential text from future versions.

We remain focused on the purchase price and do not view USD 41.5 million as supportable. Please revise the draft to reflect a materially lower price, and we can continue to work through the remaining points on that basis.

One housekeeping item: the version circulated appears to contain hidden internal text. Please ensure any such material is removed from future circulated drafts.

Best regards,
Bellweather Croft LLP
